# Emerion Dashboard — Copilot Context

This directory provides compact architectural, API and product context for Copilot so it can reason with minimal tokens. It is intentionally high-level and references backend repositories for detailed legacy semantics.

Hierarchy: React architecture → API contract → Business/domain → Legacy traceability (emerion-load-service)

Guiding principle: prefer semantic, small docs that answer "what this is" and "where to look next" instead of copying large source files.
